messages:
ada: Kicking off a small spike: show per-query-path cost in Console (route -> final_sku -> prefetch impact). Need opinions on telemetry shape + sampling defaults.

james: Quick Q: do we emit full per-request tokens or stream sampled aggregates? Per-request is exact but heavy.

ada: Tradeoff: exact for recent windows (5m/1h) so drilldowns feel realtime, sampled/rollup beyond that. Reservoir sampling + periodic rollups seems reasonable.

nina: UX: card with route sparkline; expand shows stacked breakdown (direct token cost vs apportioned cache savings). Click to see top qpaths with qpath_id and sample rate.

ryan: Router must emit lineage_ref so we can attribute final_sku even after fallbacks. Otherwise cache credits jump around when routing changes.

james: Implementation: emit small event per request: qpath_id, route, tokens_in, cache_hit(bool), final_sku(optional). Full lineage stored separately keyed by qpath_id. Keeps event size low.

claire: Finance wants an admin CSV export: qpath_id, credited_sku, apportioned_cost_usd, credited_cost_usd, sample_method. Can we expose POST /internal/exports/qpaths?

ada: Yes. Exports include metadata: sampling_window_used and confidence_interval when sampled. Default export behavior: exact counts for <=24h, sampled estimates for >24h.

nina: For external customers default to "credited owner" to avoid confusion. Internal users get "apportioned" toggle. Tooltip explains difference and links to docs.

ryan: Also show per-route quota usage in the same panel (burst_limit, used) to spot quota-driven rerouting causing cost spikes.

james: Note: adding qpath_id increases index cardinality. Use a compact 64-bit hash string and route it to low-cardinality index. Allow redaction for public logs.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: schema "qpath-compact-v3" rolling to canary-us-east :rocket:

ada: Simulation idea: slider to move X% traffic between SKUs and simulate delta in monthly token spend and cache-hit rate. Base projection on recent 7d sample and show uncertainty band.

claire: CSV should include both apportioned and credited columns so billing teams can pick. Also include source_note about sampling algorithm.

nina: UI copy: include short sentence about why apportioned can differ from charged invoice and show a "confidence" badge when estimates used.

james: I'll open the telemetry PR adding qpath_id emission + small lineage table and a shim that materializes qpath -> lineage docs asynchronously.

ada: Thanks. I'll draft RFC + wireframes and add the export API spec. If anyone objects to apportioned default for internal view, speak now.

ryan: +1 apportioned default for internal.

nina: +1

claire: +1

ops-bot: deploy-bot: canary reports schema healthy in 2m :white_check_mark:

ada: Filing RFC now.
